description: SQL Injection in product search by concatenating user input directly into a raw SQL query.
expectedDetection: Detector should find raw string concatenation of the 'q' parameter in the Postgres query.

description: Reflected XSS by rendering the search query parameter unescaped via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
expectedDetection: Detector should identify untrusted user input from searchParams passed into dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

description: Missing Row-Level Security on orders table, and API fetching orders by client-supplied user ID parameter.
expectedDetection: Detector should flag the orders table lacking RLS policies and the API querying based on unverified userId parameter.

description: Exposed Admin API Secret Key referenced in a client-side component.
expectedDetection: Detector should catch the hardcoded secret key in the client-side bundle.

description: Business rule requiring manager approval for refunds over ₹5000 is bypassed by a duplicate quickRefund function.
expectedDetection: Detector should notice the discrepancy between the stated intent contract and the implementation of quickRefund.

description: Silent functional failure applying 0% tax rate when BUGGY_MODE=true, returning HTTP 200.
expectedDetection: Detector should infer incorrect logic based on logged inputs and outputs despite 200 OK status.

description: Unhandled error thrown when an order has zero items if CRASH_MODE=true.
expectedDetection: Detector should catch the unhandled exception error trace triggered by the specific edge case.

description: Order total calculation logic is duplicated in three different places.
expectedDetection: Detector should identify identical or highly similar business logic repeated across multiple files.
